name: centurion_v6
label: Centurion v6 / v6.1
requires: luau + luau-ast + luau-compile (stock 0.734 works for v6-static)
notes: Tested on the repo's own samples with stock Luau 0.734. v6-static route (c3 factories, e.g. somerandomobfidk.txt): PARTIAL readable payload (98 factories, FindFirstChildOfClass/GetAttribute logic visible, a few stray '\\x' escapes). It never executes the input (static AST + regex) -> safe. v6.1 sandbox route (Centurion6.1v*.txt, centuration7th.lua): all 4 samples verdict NEEDS ('invalid argument #1 to create (size)' / index nil) - needs the author's patched Luau (vector metatable writable, build_luau.py) and live Roblox ('use live-harness'); exit 5. Fix applied to src/centurion.py harvest_table_spans_ast: stock luau-ast emits AstExprIndexExpr + AstExprLocal (author's build: AstExprIndex + AstExprGlobal). README env vars are wrong: real names are CENT_LUAU_LUAU / CENT_LUAU_LUAU_AST / CENT_LUAU_LUAU_COMPILE. Legacy Windows paths (C:\\Users\\goldl\\...) in source are dead fallbacks.
